purpose: ADR-027 G-2 evidence-packet item 5 (artifact manifest + hashes) for the NAFEMS LE10 thick-plate benchmark candidate. Seals the committed evidence set: any byte change to a sealed file must be a deliberate, reviewed event (tests/test_le10_artifact_manifest.py re-hashes on every PR).
claim_tier: Tier 1 engineering candidate, public-benchmark cross-check (registry overlay: tier_2_validated). NOT signed validation - G-2 items 6 (reproduce-CLI audit log, ADR-027 V2-2) and 7 (independent signoff, owner-authorized per ADR-023) remain open.

local_only_artifacts_not_sealed.note: Solver outputs (*.frd/*.dat/*.sta/*.cvg/*.12d/spooles.out) and the gmsh intermediate (le10.inp/le10.geo) are deliberately NOT in version control (.gitignore policy: only inputs enter VC). The committed deck data/run_40_20_6_C3D20/solve.inp is self-contained (no *INCLUDE); the live re-solve that regenerates the outputs runs in CI on every PR (.github/workflows/ci.yml job real-le10-e2e).

benchmark_provenance.published_target: sigma_yy at point D = 5.38 MPa magnitude
benchmark_provenance.sign_convention_note: The first-party NAFEMS table prints the target as +5.38 MPa (tension-positive rendering; mirrored verbatim by the Abaqus Benchmarks Guide, which cites TNSB Rev.3 October 1990). This project anchors -5.38 MPa: the global-Y solver-output rendering that ccx/FeenoX produce at D. Same physical quantity; both renderings must accompany any outward claim.
